reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id AND ph.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE ph.list_price_eur > (
  SELECT AVG(ph2.list_price_eur)
  FROM price_history ph2
  JOIN products p2 ON p2.product_id = ph2.product_id
  WHERE ph2.valid_to IS NULL
    AND p2.category_id = p.category_id
)
alternatives:
WITH current_prices AS (
  -- one row per product
  SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
),
category_avg AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(list_price_eur) AS avg_price_eur
  FROM current_prices
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.category_id, c.list_price_eur
FROM current_prices c
JOIN category_avg a ON a.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.list_price_eur > a.avg_price_eur

SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, ph.list_price_eur
FROM products p
JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
  AND ph.list_price_eur > (
    SELECT AVG(ph2.list_price_eur)
    FROM products p2
    JOIN price_history ph2 ON ph2.product_id = p2.product_id
    WHERE p2.category_id = p.category_id
      AND ph2.valid_to IS NULL
  )

  FROM products p
  JOIN price_history ph ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
  WHERE ph.valid_to IS NULL
),
category_avg AS (
  -- one row per category
  SELECT category_id, AVG(list_price_eur) AS avg_price_eur
  FROM current_prices
  GROUP BY category_id
)
SELECT c.product_id, c.category_id, c.list_price_eur
FROM current_prices c
JOIN category_avg a ON a.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.list_price_eur > a.avg_price_eur
other_way.tradeoff: Two WITH steps, current prices and then one average per category, name each grain but take twice the lines.

solver.query:
WITH cur AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.category_id, h.list_price_eur FROM products p JOIN price_history h ON h.product_id = p.product_id WHERE h.valid_to IS NULL)
SELECT product_id, category_id, list_price_eur FROM cur c WHERE list_price_eur > (SELECT AVG(c2.list_price_eur) FROM cur c2 WHERE c2.category_id = c.category_id)
